d2Pages.creators.hero.title: Keep {creatorShare} from your first sub
d2Pages.creators.hero.titleNoShare: Go live on a platform you co-own
d2Pages.creators.hero.body: Card fees come out of the co-op's share, not yours. No follower count or points to earn first. Only a member vote can change the split.

d2Pages.creators.calc.intro: Move the sliders to your numbers. Each platform's row says what its rate needs and where the figure comes from.
d2Pages.creators.calc.priceHint: Kick's sub price is fixed at {price}.
d2Pages.creators.calc.private: Nothing you enter here leaves this page.
d2Pages.creators.calc.detail: From {gross} in subs and tips. The co-op keeps {coop} and pays the card fees from it.
d2Pages.creators.calc.secondary: {platform}: from a secondary source, because its help pages couldn't be read directly. Last checked {checkedDate}.
d2Pages.creators.calc.noShare: The calculator needs the co-op's current split, which didn't load.
d2Pages.creators.cond.commonair: From your first sub. Card fees are paid by the co-op.
d2Pages.creators.cond.kick: {share} of subs with KICK Streamer status. Subs are a flat {price}. Tips: {tipShare}.
d2Pages.creators.cond.youtube: {share} of net for memberships and Super Chat, inside the YouTube Partner Program.
d2Pages.creators.cond.twitch: {share} of net by default, {altShare} after 3 months in a row of 300 or more Plus Points. Tips arrive as Bits, which this row leaves out.
d2Pages.creators.cond.patreon: A {fee} platform fee plus card processing, here {cardRate} + {cardFixed} a payment. Patreon's real rate varies by country and currency.
d2Pages.creators.cond.kofi: {fee} on memberships and none on tips (free plan), plus card processing, here {cardRate} + {cardFixed} a payment.
d2Pages.creators.note.ours: {site}: {creatorShare} of each sub and tip after sales tax. Card fees are paid from the co-op's share.
d2Pages.creators.note.payout: Payouts go out monthly once you've earned {minimum}, after a {holdDays, plural, one {#-day} other {#-day}} hold.
d2Pages.creators.note.sources: Other platforms' rates as published on their source pages, last checked {checkedDate}. Each row links its source.
d2Pages.creators.note.kick: Kick pays a higher share of subs ({share}) once you reach KICK Streamer status.
d2Pages.creators.note.twitch: Twitch: {defaultShare} by default. Higher rates after three months in a row of earning Plus Points.
d2Pages.creators.note.assumptions: Patreon and Ko-fi card processing is counted at {cardRate} + {cardFixed} a payment, with an average tip of {tip}. Twitch Bits aren't counted.
d2Pages.creators.note.estimate: Estimates only, before your own taxes and currency conversion. Refunds and chargebacks lower real earnings.
d2Pages.creators.note.vote: The {creatorShare} is a co-op setting. Changing it takes a protected member vote.
d2Pages.creators.gate.title: No audience gate to turn on support
d2Pages.creators.gate.earn.title: Earn from day one
d2Pages.creators.gate.earn.body: Set up sub tiers and tips before your first stream. There's no follower count, hours target or points level to reach first.
d2Pages.creators.gate.fees.title: Card fees aren't yours
d2Pages.creators.gate.fees.body: The co-op pays card processing from its share. Your {creatorShare} is counted before any fees.
d2Pages.creators.gate.fees.bodyNoShare: The co-op pays card processing from its share, so card fees never come out of yours.
d2Pages.creators.gate.owner.title: You become an owner
d2Pages.creators.gate.owner.body: Stream {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} to {viewers, plural, one {# or more verified viewers} other {# or more verified viewers}} within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and you're a streamer member, with a vote on the split and everything else.
d2Pages.creators.gate.owner.bodyNoRules: Creators who stream regularly become streamer members automatically, with a vote on the split and everything else.
d2Pages.creators.gate.payout: Payouts are monthly, with a {minimum} minimum and a {holdDays, plural, one {#-day} other {#-day}} hold.
d2Pages.creators.steps.title: Go live in {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}
d2Pages.creators.steps.account.title: Create your account
d2Pages.creators.steps.account.body: Your username is your channel address.
d2Pages.creators.steps.channel.title: Set up your channel
d2Pages.creators.steps.channel.body: Name, avatar, colors and a category.
d2Pages.creators.steps.encoder.title: Connect your encoder
d2Pages.creators.steps.encoder.body: Copy your stream key into OBS or any encoder that sends RTMP or WHIP.
d2Pages.creators.steps.live.title: Rehearse, then go live
d2Pages.creators.steps.live.body: Test privately first, then go public when it looks right.
d2Pages.creators.steps.works: Works with OBS, Streamlabs, FFmpeg and phone encoders that send RTMP or WHIP.
d2Pages.creators.import.title: Bring your audience
d2Pages.creators.import.twitch.title: Import from Twitch
d2Pages.creators.import.twitch.body: Bring over your channel's details and emotes instead of retyping them. Followers, past videos and your schedule stay where they are.
d2Pages.creators.import.move.title: Move links
d2Pages.creators.import.move.body: Share one link on your old channel. Viewers who click it can follow you here, and you see how many came over.
d2Pages.creators.tools.title: Tools other platforms don't have
d2Pages.creators.tools.verified.title: Verified viewer counts
d2Pages.creators.tools.verified.body: Bots don't count. Sponsors can check your numbers with a signed viewer count proof.
d2Pages.creators.tools.breakdown.title: Where the money went
d2Pages.creators.tools.breakdown.body: Every payment comes with a breakdown of what reached you and what the co-op kept.
d2Pages.creators.tools.rehearsal.title: Rehearsal mode
d2Pages.creators.tools.rehearsal.body: Run your real setup privately, seen only by you and up to five followers you invite.
d2Pages.creators.tools.bundle.title: Leave with your channel
d2Pages.creators.tools.bundle.body: Take your channel's setup with you in a bundle, with a signed statement of its standing here.
d2Pages.creators.cut.title: Members do, in the open
d2Pages.creators.cut.body: The split is a co-op setting. Changing it needs a protected vote, and the database refuses any change that didn't pass one. Every change is published with its date and the vote behind it.
d2Pages.creators.cut.link: Fee history on the transparency page
d2Pages.creators.cut.changes: {changes, plural, =0 {The split hasn't changed since the co-op set it up.} one {Members have changed the split # time.} other {Members have changed the split # times.}}
d2Pages.creators.faq.title: Questions
d2Pages.creators.faq.fee.a: Yes: {coopShare} of each sub and tip goes to the co-op. It pays for video, card processing, moderation and the people who run the platform. You keep {creatorShare}, and card fees never come out of your share.
d2Pages.creators.faq.paid.a: Monthly, once you've earned {minimum}. Each payment waits {holdDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} first, so refunds and chargebacks can settle.
d2Pages.creators.faq.compare.q: How is this different from Twitch or Kick?
d2Pages.creators.faq.compare.a: Kick pays a higher share of subs ({kickShare}) once you have KICK Streamer status. Twitch pays {twitchShare} by default and up to {twitchAlt} after months of earning Plus Points. Here you get {creatorShare} from your first sub, card fees aren't yours, and the split only changes by a member vote you take part in.
d2Pages.creators.faq.leave.a: Download your account data, and take your channel's setup with you in a bundle.
d2Pages.creators.faq.leave.share: If you hold a {shareAmount} member share, it's refunded when you leave.
d2Pages.creators.faq.mature.a: Yes, when the stream is labelled mature. Only signed-in viewers who confirmed they're 18 or older can watch it, and some content is never allowed.
d2Pages.creators.faq.owner.a: Its members: streamers, viewers who hold a share or subscribe at {minSub} or more a month, and workers. One member, one vote. The books are published every month.
d2Pages.creators.faq.owner.aNoSub: Its members: streamers, viewers who hold a member share, and workers. One member, one vote. The books are published every month.
d2Pages.creators.faq.change.a: Only by a protected member vote, which needs {memberWide} of members and {streamerClass} of streamer members voting yes. Every change is dated and public.

d2Pages.creators.claim.hint: 3 to 25 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
d2Pages.creators.claim.invalid: Use 3 to 25 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
d2Pages.creators.claim.unchecked: We'll check {name} when you create your account.
d2Pages.coopBand.title: Own a piece of the platform you watch
d2Pages.coopBand.share: A {shareAmount} share makes you a member, refunded if you leave.
d2Pages.coopBand.shareKept: A {shareAmount} share makes you a member.
d2Pages.coopBand.sub: Or subscribe to any channel at {minSub} or more a month.
d2Pages.coopBand.streamers: Streamers join automatically once they've streamed {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
d2Pages.coopBand.generic: Hold a member share or subscribe to a channel to join. Streamers join automatically.
d2Pages.patronage.intro: How the co-op can share money left over at the end of a year, and how each member's contribution is counted.
d2Pages.patronage.what.title: What patronage is
d2Pages.patronage.what.body: If the co-op ends a year with money left over, members can vote to share it by contribution. Nothing is shared unless members vote for it.
d2Pages.patronage.now.title: Where it stands
d2Pages.patronage.now.deficit: Right now costs are higher than income, so there is nothing to share yet.
d2Pages.patronage.now.surplus: Over the last {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} the co-op had {amount} left over. Members decide whether to share any of it.
d2Pages.patronage.now.shared: Members have shared {amount} by contribution in that time.
d2Pages.patronage.formula.title: How contribution is counted
d2Pages.patronage.formula.intro: The weights are a protected co-op setting, so members change them only by a protected vote.
d2Pages.patronage.join.title: Members get a statement for every period
d2Pages.patronage.join.body: Create a free account and join the co-op to see your own statement, line by line.
d2Pages.jury.who.title: Who can serve
d2Pages.jury.who.body: Adult co-op members in good standing can put themselves in the monthly draw. Platform staff never sit on the jury.
d2Pages.jury.who.bodyOff: When the co-op turns the jury on, adult co-op members in good standing can put themselves in its draw. Platform staff never sit on the jury.
d2Pages.jury.join.title: Members put themselves in the draw
d2Pages.jury.join.body: Create a free account and join the co-op, then turn on the draw from this page.
d2Pages.jury.join.titleOff: Members decide whether there is a jury
d2Pages.jury.join.bodyOff: Create a free account and join the co-op to have a say in turning the jury on, and to serve on it once it is.
